about: Grand Falls-Windsor is a town in central Newfoundland and Labrador on the Exploits River, formed by amalgamating Grand Falls and Windsor. Pulp-and-paper heritage, salmon fishing, and a role as an inland service hub for the island’s interior define the community. About 14,000 people live in Grand Falls-Windsor.
